dest:port-moresby:header.why: Blue bay curving round a headland of towers and beaches; 3:2, 4928 px; sea on left, so subject sits right of centre.
City and port skyline but flat grey sky, container yard fills the foreground.
Same headland, but branches cross the corner of the frame.
Stilt village in foreground dominates, branch in the corner.

dest:port-moresby:why1.why: Real Ela Beach, sand and bay with hills; shows the beach, not a promenade or anyone walking.

dest:port-moresby:why1.file: Sea and islands from hill above Ela Beach.jpg
dest:port-moresby:why1.why: View from a hill, beach barely visible.

dest:port-moresby:why2.file: CDRUSINDOPACOM Visits Port Moresby (Bomana) War Cemetery (8529263).jpg
dest:port-moresby:why2.why: Cross of Sacrifice, lawn and rows of headstones at Bomana, no people, 3:2, sunlit; cross is central.

dest:port-moresby:why2.file: View of Nine-Mile Quarry from Bomana War Cemetery near Port Moresby.jpg
dest:port-moresby:why2.why: Accepted as spot photo, but portrait (2448x3264): fails the landscape rule for a why-visit card.

dest:port-moresby:why2.file: CDRUSINDOPACOM Visits Port Moresby (Bomana) War Cemetery (8529267).jpg
dest:port-moresby:why2.why: Close rows of headstones with flowers; fine but tighter.

dest:port-moresby:why2.file: CDRUSINDOPACOM Visits Port Moresby (Bomana) War Cemetery (8529261).jpg
dest:port-moresby:why2.why: Inscription 'Their name liveth for evermore' in foreground, cemetery behind; wall text is the subject.

dest:port-moresby:why3.file: Papua New Guinea 1991-039 Parliament House, Port Moresby (33351725760).jpg
dest:port-moresby:why3.why: Haus Tambaran with its pool; colour film slide taken 1991 (uploaded 2017), so fails the 'about 2000' date rule on metadata, though the building is unchanged. Only landscape Parliament photo found; second judge / owner to decide.

dest:port-moresby:why3.file: Papua New Guinea National Museum May 2015.jpg
dest:port-moresby:why3.why: Museum is a small gable behind trees; garden is the subject.

dest:rabaul:header.why: Town, Simpson Harbour and Tavurvur in one 4:3 view, blue sky; fine as town header (taken 2012). Tavurvur is at the left, so needs a subject point.
Low aerial of a wharf and jungle slope, not the town in its landscape.
Featured picture of the caldera cones with a plume; fine landscape but no town.

dest:rabaul:why1.why: Tavurvur erupting beyond blue water, bright, landscape; shows the volcano, not a climb.
Orange sunset plume; retouched and dark foreground.

dest:rabaul:why2.why: It is literally the view from the observatory lookout, Tavurvur on the left; also the header (same destination, allowed).

dest:rabaul:why3.why: Tunnel mouth with a barge visible inside, 2816x2112 (local copy 1920 px, already pinned as spot photo); tunnel mouth centred, mostly leaves and shade but recognisable.

dest:madang:header.why: Outrigger-style boat on Madang lagoon, palm-fringed island and hills behind, 4:3, 3648 px; no town visible but this is Madang's lagoon-and-islands setting. Water fills the lower half, so zoom. Photographed 2011-02-15.
Verandah of a building covers a third of the frame, grey sky.

dest:madang:why1.why: Crater rim and cone of Mount Uluman on Karkar Island, 3:2, bright; cone centred low, so zoom ~1.3 with y 0.6 helps.

dest:madang:why2.why: Covered market hall with produce and shoppers; original 1800x1200, local copy is a brightened 1024 px. Flickr date 2000-05-03 (edge of the date rule) and it is a plain, dated snapshot; no better CC market photo found (other Flickr Madang-market shots are produce close-ups).

dest:alotau:header.why: 1440 px; low view of a bay shore, under 2000.

dest:alotau:why1.why: Robinsons Anchorage off Kuwanak Island: hills across open water. Shows the archipelago's sea and islands but no boat/cruise; existing subject point {x .6,y .35,zoom 1.6} trims sea.

dest:alotau:why2.why: Thatched-roof memorial shelter with plaque at Alotau, 2023, 1725x1142; shows a WWII memorial, not reefs. Description is just 'alotau memorial-ww2'; unverified what battle it commemorates.

dest:alotau:why2.file: Flickr 7868919038 et al (klm_pics 2012 dive & kite trip)
dest:alotau:why2.why: 1024 px, location not stated as Milne Bay.
